name: cgc-seo
description: Quartz 5 plugin for what search engines and feed readers see: noindex on private pages, canonical URLs, article metadata and JSON-LD, the sitemap and the RSS feed. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: head elements must be the host's Preact vnodes.
//devDependencies: Build-time only, and inlined into dist by build.mjs (tags-core, our library, and reading-time, v4's reading-time counter): the loader prunes them after `npm run build`. tags-core is a `file:` spec on main, which a release commit rewrites to the release's published version (ADR-0005). It is a library, not the cgc-tags engine, so inlining it adds no plugin dependency.
